title: MI-VAL Preprocessing Recipe
description: An ordered list of registered ops with parameters. Hashable and serializable, so a methods section can cite recipe@hash instead of prose. Ops declare the MI-CDM attributes they read; the engine refuses to run an op whose attribute is missing rather than assuming a default.
$comment: Built-in ECG ops: select_leads, resample, bandpass, notch, crop_or_pad, scale_units, normalize, drop_if_flat. Built-in image ops: apply_voi_lut, resize, rescale_intensity. Run `mival ops` for the live registry including site-registered ops.
